hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.agents/workflow-kit-hook.mjs"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || for r in "$HOME/.local/share/fnm" "$HOME/.fnm" "$HOME/Library/Application Support/fnm" "$HOME/AppData/Roaming/fnm" "$FNM_DIR"; do for n in "$(ls -d "$r"/node-versions/*/installation 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1)" "$r/aliases/default/installation"; do if [ -f "$n/node.exe" ] || [ -f "$n/bin/node" ]; then PATH="$n/bin:$n:$PATH"; fi; done; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || for d in "$(ls -d "$HOME"/.nvm/versions/node/*/bin 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -n 1)" "$HOME/.volta/bin" "$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims" /opt/homebrew/bin; do if [ -x "$d/node" ]; then PATH="$PATH:$d"; fi; done; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ] && exec node "$f" UserPromptSubmit --agent codex; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: $p = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { '.' }; $f = "$p/.agents/workflow-kit-hook.mjs"; if ((Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { $input | node $f UserPromptSubmit --agent codex; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; exit 0
